description: Connect ChatGPT to your Queli CRM account to find companies, people, deals, contracts, tickets, and projects you are authorized to access. Browse available fields and run bounded searches from ChatGPT. Queli enforces workspace membership and role permissions. This version cannot create, update, or delete records, and it does not expose email content.
